name: tournament-director
description: Convenience scripts only. web/ and api/ keep their own package.json; this is not an npm workspace.

scripts.setup: npm ci && npm --prefix api ci && npm --prefix web ci
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm --prefix api run dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.check: npm --prefix api run lint && npm --prefix api run format:check && npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix api test && npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run format:check && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix web test
